```{r cars}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Read in the edgeR output file
df <- read_tsv("/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/bams_Project_3969_plus_project_3983_presudoreplicates_AOS_0.13/twogroup/comparison2/comparison2_diffacc_edgeR.tsv")

# 2. Define significance status based on FDR threshold (< 0.05)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    FDR < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Enriched in A485",
    FDR < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Enriched in ctrl",
    TRUE                   ~ "Not Significant"
  ))

# 3. Dynamically count the number of peaks in each group for the labels
counts <- table(df$Status)
label_ctrl  <- paste0("Enriched in ctrl (", counts["Enriched in ctrl"], ")")
label_a485  <- paste0("Enriched in A485 (", counts["Enriched in A485"], ")")
label_nosig <- paste0("Not Significant (", counts["Not Significant"], ")")

# 4. Define the color palette mapping directly to the new dynamic labels
group_colors <- c(
  "Enriched in ctrl" = "#de2d26",   # Red
  "Enriched in A485" = "#3182bd",   # Blue
  "Not Significant"  = "#d9d9d9"    # Muted light gray
)

# Replace status strings with the ones containing parenthetical counts
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Status_Label = case_when(
    Status == "Enriched in ctrl" ~ label_ctrl,
    Status == "Enriched in A485" ~ label_a485,
    TRUE                         ~ label_nosig
  ))

# Create a named vector for the scale mapping using the exact label strings
color_labels <- c(group_colors["Enriched in ctrl"], 
                  group_colors["Enriched in A485"], 
                  group_colors["Not Significant"])
names(color_labels) <- c(label_ctrl, label_a485, label_nosig)


# ==========================================
# Plot 1: Corrected MA Plot with Dynamic Labels
# ==========================================
ma_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logCPM, y = logFC, color = Status_Label)) +
  # Render non-significant background points first
  geom_point(data = filter(df, Status == "Not Significant"), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  # Overlay the significant points on top
  geom_point(data = filter(df, Status != "Not Significant"), alpha = 0.9, size = 1.5) +
  
  # Reference line at y = 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = color_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Differential Chromatin Accessibility",
    subtitle = "Statistical Significance Threshold: FDR < 0.05",
    x = "Average Abundance (logCPM)",
    y = "Log2 Fold Change (logFC)",
    color = "Significance Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(ma_plot)


# ==========================================
# Plot 2: Bar Chart of Enriched Counts with Dynamic Labels
# ==========================================
# Filter out non-significant peaks for the bar chart
count_data <- df %>%
  filter(Status != "Not Significant") %>%
  count(Status_Label)

bar_plot <- ggplot(count_data, aes(x = Status_Label, y = n, fill = Status_Label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Significantly Enriched Peaks",
    subtitle = "Threshold: FDR < 0.05",
    x = "Experimental Group",
    y = "Peak Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(count_data$n) * 1.15)

print(bar_plot)
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
pca <- read.table("/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/bams_Project_3969_plus_project_3983_AOS13/peakset/PCAeigenvalue.tab", 
                  header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# 2. Transpose and clean up rows
pca_t <- as.data.frame(t(pca))
pca_t <- pca_t[rownames(pca_t) != "Eigenvalue", ]

# 3. Create the batch variable 
# grepl returns TRUE if "batch1" is found, FALSE otherwise
pca_t$batch <- ifelse(grepl("batch1", rownames(pca_t)), "Project_3969", "Project_3983")
pca_t$batch <- factor(pca_t$batch, levels = c("Project_3969", "Project_3983"))

# 4. Map PC coordinates
pca_t$PC1 <- as.numeric(pca_t[,1])
pca_t$PC2 <- as.numeric(pca_t[,2])

# 5. Plot using the new batch variable for color
p <- ggplot(pca_t, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Project_3969" = "red",
    "Project_3983" = "green"
  )) +
  labs(color = "Batch Status", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_classic()

p
```

#Comparing ATACseq with RNAseq
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD AND ANNOTATE ATAC-SEQ PEAKS
# ==============================================================================
atac_df <- read_tsv("/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/bams_Project_3969_plus_project_3983_presudoreplicates_AOS_0.13/twogroup/comparison2/comparison2_diffacc_edgeR.tsv")

atac_processed <- atac_df %>%
  separate(col = peak_id, into = c("chr", "start", "end"), sep = "\\|", convert = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(chr = if_else(grepl("^chr", chr), chr, paste0("chr", chr)))

atac_granges <- GRanges(
  seqnames = atac_processed$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = atac_processed$start, end = atac_processed$end),
  atac_logFC = atac_processed$logFC,
  atac_FDR = atac_processed$FDR
)

txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
atac_annotated <- annotatePeak(atac_granges, tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000), 
                               TxDb = txdb, annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db")

atac_annotated_df <- as.data.frame(atac_annotated) %>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, atac_logFC, atac_FDR, distanceToTSS, annotation)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LOAD DESEQ2 RNA-SEQ DATA AND INTEGRATE
# ==============================================================================
deseq_col_names <- c("ensembl_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", 
                     "stat", "pvalue", "padj", "Status", "external_gene_name")
rna_raw <- read_tsv(
  "/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/RNA_pseudoreps_analysis/DESeq2_SampleSheet_RNAseq_preudoreps/DEseq_basic_DEresults.tsv",
  skip = 1, 
  col_names = deseq_col_names
)

rna_df <- rna_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj) & !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    SYMBOL = external_gene_name,
    rna_logFC = log2FoldChange,
    rna_FDR = padj
  )

# Merge datasets by official Gene Symbol and filter for proximal promoter/TSS hits (<= 5kb)
integrated_df <- inner_join(atac_annotated_df, rna_df, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
  filter(abs(distanceToTSS) <= 10000)

# Step A: Initially assign the baseline statuses
integrated_df <- integrated_df %>%
  mutate(Status_Base = case_when(
    atac_FDR < 0.05 & rna_FDR < 0.05 & atac_logFC > 0 & rna_logFC > 0 ~ "Co-upregulated (Open & Expressed)",
    atac_FDR < 0.05 & rna_FDR < 0.05 & atac_logFC < 0 & rna_logFC < 0 ~ "Co-downregulated (Closed & Silenced)",
    atac_FDR < 0.05 & rna_FDR < 0.05                                  ~ "Inverse Regulation",
    TRUE                                                               ~ "Not Concordant / Not Sig"
  ))

# Step B: Compute the unique counts for each category safely
counts <- table(integrated_df$Status_Base)

# Step C: Generate text labels containing the parenthetical count values
# (Using dynamic lookup to default to 0 if a group happens to have no elements)
get_count <- function(name) if (name %in% names(counts)) counts[name] else 0

label_coup   <- paste0("Co-upregulated (Open & Expressed) (", get_count("Co-upregulated (Open & Expressed)"), ")")
label_codown <- paste0("Co-downregulated (Closed & Silenced) (", get_count("Co-downregulated (Closed & Silenced)"), ")")
label_inv    <- paste0("Inverse Regulation (", get_count("Inverse Regulation"), ")")
label_nosig  <- paste0("Not Concordant / Not Sig (", get_count("Not Concordant / Not Sig"), ")")

# Step D: Apply the finalized text strings with counts into a new variable column
integrated_df <- integrated_df %>%
  mutate(Regulation_Label = case_when(
    Status_Base == "Co-upregulated (Open & Expressed)"   ~ label_coup,
    Status_Base == "Co-downregulated (Closed & Silenced)" ~ label_codown,
    Status_Base == "Inverse Regulation"                   ~ label_inv,
    TRUE                                                   ~ label_nosig
  ))

# Save the updated table summary
write_tsv(integrated_df, "integrated_atac_rna_summary.tsv")


# ==============================================================================
# 3. VISUALIZATION: STARBURST PLOT WITH DYNAMIC LABELS
# ==============================================================================
# Build custom hex color palettes mapped exactly to the explicit new text labels
integration_colors <- c(
  "#74c476", # Green
  "#3182bd", # Blue
  "#de2d26", # Red
  "#d9d9d9"  # Muted light gray
)
names(integration_colors) <- c(label_coup, label_codown, label_inv, label_nosig)

starburst_plot <- ggplot(integrated_df, aes(x = atac_logFC, y = rna_logFC)) +
  # 1. Render non-significant/non-concordant background points first
  geom_point(data = filter(integrated_df, Status_Base == "Not Concordant / Not Sig"), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1, color = "#d9d9d9") +
  # 2. Overlay significant integrated multi-omic targets on top
  geom_point(data = filter(integrated_df, Status_Base != "Not Concordant / Not Sig"), 
             aes(color = Regulation_Label), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  
  # Crosshair lines at 0 coordinates
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Label top multi-omic genes (highest fold shifts)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(integrated_df, Status_Base != "Not Concordant / Not Sig" & 
                   (abs(atac_logFC) > 1 | abs(rna_logFC) > 1)),
    aes(label = SYMBOL),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 15,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = integration_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "ATAC-seq vs. RNA-seq",
    subtitle = "Peaks restricted within 10kb of target Gene TSS",
    x = "Chromatin Accessibility Change (ATAC-seq logFC)",
    y = "Gene Expression Change (DESeq2 log2FoldChange)",
    color = "Integration Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(starburst_plot)
```
